name: Prospero's Hoard
purpose: Directs a media studio (ComfyUI, ffmpeg, TTS) to produce consistent characters (model sheets, local LoRA training, portable character packs), photocards, album art, beat-cut music videos as resumable productions and reusable recipes, narrated vertical shorts from a topic or a script (voice-over, word-by-word captions, stock or generated pictures, ducked music), cloned voices, audiobooks and dubbed video.
notes: A media studio: characters, generated photocards/covers, songs, beat-cut music videos as resumable productions and reusable recipes, narrated shorts with stock or generated pictures, cloned voices, audiobooks and dubbed video, driven through ComfyUI/ffmpeg/TTS/STT. Does not host any model itself.
